score_notes.denominational: Independent Baptist with plural elder structure: 9 pastors (Nathan Smith Sr. Pastor; Kevin Haglund, Dave Ashburn, Nathan Fox, Joshua Hankins, Rob [Pastor Rob], Jeff Scott, Allen Waldrep, Mike Crump) + 4 lay elders (Keith Metzler, Matt Hankins, Ben Forrest, Matt Durand) per /staff/. Pastor Nathan Smith holds DMin in Expository Preaching from The Master's Seminary — confessional tie to Master's-adjacent network. Published 'What We Believe' affirms inerrancy. Upgrade to yellow: confirmed elder plurality + Master's Seminary credentialing pathway.

Independent Bible church with structured elder plurality: volunteer board of 12–20 voting Elders elected per Titus 1:6–9 and 1 Tim 3:1–7 qualifications, 4-year terms with sabbaticals, chosen by nominating committee and congregational vote. Published 10-point Statement of Faith affirming inerrancy, Trinity, substitutionary atonement, bodily resurrection. Per refined rubric: independent with plurality of male elders + published polity + strong doctrinal statement = yellow.

Independent with plural elder structure: 9-man elder board (Bryce Gray, Doug Kempton [Lead Pastor], John Carter, Lloyd Clopton [Chairman], Mark Lubienski, Matt Mancinelli [in training], Murray Sales, Wayne Manchester [in training], Wayne Stapleton) per /about-us/staff-directory/. Upgrade to yellow on accountability structure alone; cultural/DEI concerns remain addressed under `cultural` dimension.

Independent but with plural ruling-elder governance: 6 ruling elders (Kelly All, Matt Beach, Peter Francis, David Gohrband, Lori Lucy, Bobby Pauley) + 9 deacons, three-year terms per /leadership. Elder plurality confirmed — upgrade to yellow on governance.
score_notes.gender: Elder board includes at least two apparently female names (Lori Lucy; possibly Kelly All) — egalitarian elder practice = red per rubric. Downgrade gender from yellow.

enrichment_notes: Elder plurality warrants yellow on denominational axis, but the same leadership page reveals apparent female ruling elders — material flag on gender dimension.

score_notes.denominational: Independent Baptist affiliated with Baptist Bible Fellowship International (BBFI) per external directories — BBFI is a named fundamental Baptist fellowship with shared missions/credentialing. Four pastors listed on /leadership: Brandon Hudson (Lead), Joel Achenbach (Asst.), David Lavoie (Admin), Jorge Paez (Hispanic). Published beliefs affirm Bible as 'verbally inspired, inerrant, infallible.' Upgrade to yellow: named fellowship affiliation (BBFI) + multiple pastoral staff.

Independent non-denominational with plural pastor/elder structure per /governance: five named pastors (Tim Howey Sr. Pastor; Brian Gann Exec/Olathe; Christopher Fetters North OP; Kent Liles Spiritual Dev/Online; Ben Abu Saada Worship). Site explicitly frames pastors as 'elders, bishops, pastors' — plurality language. Separate Board of Directors uses Carver policy governance. ECFA-accredited. Upgrade to yellow: verifiable plural eldership + published governance structure.

Independent Fundamental Baptist with 5 named pastors per /staff/ (Wayne Van Gelderen Sr. Pastor; Stephen Van Gelderen; Mark Gillmore; Stephen Zempel; Ken Shaver). Church operates Baptist College of Ministry (BCM) — institutional discipleship/credentialing pipeline acts as network-equivalent. IFB fundamentalist camp affiliations confirmed. Upgrade to yellow: multiple pastors + tied institution (BCM) constitute at least one network-level affiliation.

Non-denominational mega-church (founded 1962). Wikipedia/third-party sources reference an Elder Board but no current elder roster surfaced; Jud Wilhite personality-driven since 2003; no confessional body, no named network affiliation (9Marks/Acts 29/TGC/Founders) found. Restoration Movement heritage is cultural not accountability-structural. Keep red: single dominant personality (Wilhite 20+ yrs) with no verifiable plural-elder roster and no network affiliation.

Independent seeker-sensitive multi-site with founder-driven leadership (Ray Johnston since founding; Mark Clark Global Sr. Pastor). /leadership page lists campus pastors and executives but no elder board / plurality structure. Wikipedia reference to Evangelical Covenant Church affiliation not confirmed on church's own pages; no 9Marks/Acts 29/TGC/Founders tie visible. Keep red: no verifiable elder plurality AND no verifiable network affiliation.

Fully independent evangelical megachurch; Miles McPherson is founder/Sr. Pastor 2000–present — personality-driven 5-campus structure. /about lists only Pastor Miles by name; no elder board surfaced; no denominational or network affiliation (Acts 29/9Marks/TGC/Calvary Chapel) visible on site. Keep red: single dominant personality + no elder roster + no network tie.

Non-denominational multi-campus megachurch (~23,000 attendance, 22+ campuses). /our-team/central/leadership-team lists Sr. Pastor Jason Mitchell + Exec Directors (Kreiser, Byers, Dahl, Waltman, Wishard, Gattorna) but no elder board; structure is Sr. Pastor + staff execs. No network/fellowship affiliation (9Marks/Acts 29/TGC) found. Founder Ashcraft led 1991–2023. Keep red: single dominant-pastor succession model with no verifiable elder plurality and no confessional/network accountability.

Entity identity unresolved: multiple 'Bridge Church' entities in Nashville metro (Benton Ave; Spring Hill; Columbia). The elder-governed Bridge Church TN (Simkins/McKown) is Spring Hill/Columbia — not the Benton Ave entity. No elder plurality or network affiliation verifiable for the Benton Ave site. Keep red: unable to verify any accountability structure for this specific address.

Confirmed ARC (Association of Related Churches) member — ARC explicitly states member churches are 'legally autonomous, independently led, separately operated, and solely accountable to their leadership, independent of the ARC organization.' ARC is a planting/resourcing network, not a confessional accountability body. Board of trustees governance (not elders); scandal history under Stovall Weems + litigation against ARC itself. Keep red: ARC affiliation does not satisfy rubric's accountability criterion, and demonstrated accountability failure remains.

Independent non-denominational; Lead Pastor Shea Strickland per external directory; no elder roster surfaced; no network affiliation (Acts 29/9Marks/TGC) found. Combined with stated egalitarian policy ('inclusion of women in all levels of leadership') and 'Multicultural Oneness' DEI framing, no accountability structure disciplines away from progressive drift. Keep red (overall rating black stands).

Independent non-denominational with confirmed plural eldership: elder/pastor team includes Jay Messenger (Lead), Dennis Friesen (Emeritus), Larry Gadbaugh, Bill Russell, Jim Hislop per external reporting; Bob Maddox, Gerry Smith also named pastors. Core value 'relevant exposition of the Word.' No named network, but verifiable plural male elders + expository commitment. Upgrade to yellow on plurality + governance transparency.

Post-Morris reform: 7-member elder board confirmed on /about/elders (Kenneth Fambro II, Randy McFarland, Dane Minor, Brad Moore, Oscar Morales, Mark Mueller, Tra Willbanks). Daniel Floyd + wife Tammie installed 2025 'walking closely with the elders.' Gateway historically ARC-adjacent; institutional reform ongoing. Kept red: elder plurality exists on paper now but demonstrated accountability failure (Morris decades of abuse unchecked) + ARC-family network-without-discipline + husband-wife co-lead pattern mean the structural accountability is not yet verifiable as corrective.

Independent Christian Church (Restoration Movement) with confirmed plural eldership: 8 elders named per church reporting — Robert Holtfretter, Guy Laing, Luke Leutkemeyer, Drew Moore (Lead Pastor), John Rhodes, Randy Patton, Kelly Garfield, Tony Maisonet. Co-founders Kevin Odor and Mike Breaux still on record. 8-point statement of faith. Restoration Movement is a named stream with shared identity even if non-confessional. Upgrade to yellow: verifiable elder plurality + named tradition.

Independent non-denominational with husband-wife Lead/Formation Pastor team (Filipe and Mandy Santos) and multi-site campus pastors including a female Campus Pastor (Sarah Rogers, North San Jose). No confessional body, no named accountability network; egalitarian practice is a structural accountability failure by rubric. Keep red.

Unverified SBC tie per one search result, but not confirmed on Hoboken Grace's own pages (/about, /leadership both 404 or absent). No elder roster surfaced, no named accountability network visible on site. Founder Chris High + wife Ana 'and three others' founding model remains the best evidence — founder-led. Keep red until SBC affiliation or elder plurality is verifiable on primary source.

NewSpring operates its own 'NewSpring Network' providing 'apostolic covering' to planted churches — self-referential network is not independent accountability. /staff lists 6 Lead Pastors (Brad Cooper, Riley Cummings, David Hall, Lee McDerment, Michael Mullikin, Tyler Tatum) but no elder board named. Post-Perry-Noble fallout, no confessional body or external network affiliation (9Marks/Acts 29/TGC/Founders) present. Keep red: internal 'covering' does not satisfy rubric.

Independent Christian Church (Restoration/Stone-Campbell stream) with confirmed elder board governance per Christian Standard profile (190-year history) and church reporting; elders + staff gatherings regular feature. Aaron Brockett Lead Pastor since 2007 with named elder team (third-party sources list John Shubat, Rod Duncan et al. — all male). Restoration Movement heritage is named tradition. Upgrade to yellow: elder plurality confirmed + named tradition affiliation.

Website (graceclarksville.org) returns self-signed certificate error; graceclarksville.com reachable but elder/affiliation data not surfaced through available search. No named network affiliation or elder roster verifiable from primary or secondary sources. Keep red pending direct verification.

Non-denominational megachurch network; Sr. Pastor Eric Geiger publicly states he is accountable to a monthly-meeting elder board (Christian Post 2018 installation coverage). /leadership lists extensive multi-campus pastoral team (Kenton Beshore Emeritus; Teaching Pastors Doug Fields, Ines Franklin, Ed Stetzer [Scholar in Residence], Christine Caine; 12 campus Lead Pastors including Guillermo Gonzalez Santa Ana). Eric Geiger previously VP LifeWay — Southern Baptist adjacency. Upgrade to yellow on verifiable elder accountability + scholar-in-residence Stetzer tie. Note: Christine Caine as Teaching Pastor and Erin Kerr as Mission Viejo Lead Pastor are material gender flags handled under `gender` dimension.

Independent but confirmed Acts 29 network affiliation: founder Harvey Turner serves as Acts 29 West Region Director per Outreach Magazine / YPN Reno profile; Kyle Bateson serves as Network Director. Beliefs page affirms Trinity, deity of Christ, authoritative Scripture, salvation by grace. Multi-site (Reno, Sparks, Truckee, Carson City, Elko) under named pastoral team (Bateson, Craig Parish Exec, Jason Diaz Discipleship). Upgrade to yellow: Acts 29 affiliation satisfies rubric's single-network threshold.

Self-describes as 'elder-led body... associated with no denomination and a completely unaffiliated body of believers.' Only 'Elder Quinton' surfaced on site as reference; no plural-elder roster published. Joe Reed ordained 2008 under 'Wheat and Tares Ministries' (Lorton VA) — loose credentialing body. Apostles'/Nicene Creed affirmed. Keep red: self-described 'unaffiliated' + no published elder plurality + loose ordination = genuine independent with no external accountability per rubric.

Founder-led 40+ years (J. Bruce Sofia since 1982); ECA (Evangelical Church Alliance) ordination is a loose credentialing body, not accountability. Site unreachable (ECONNREFUSED) for deeper verification; external sources confirm interdenominational self-description but no elder board surfaced and no multi-network affiliation found. Keep red: single founder + loose credentialing ≠ accountability per rubric.

Duplicate of gateway-church-southlake record — same congregation (700 Blessed Way, Southlake TX). Post-Morris reform: 7-member elder board now listed (Kenneth Fambro II, Randy McFarland, Dane Minor, Brad Moore, Oscar Morales, Mark Mueller, Tra Willbanks) per /about/elders. Demonstrated decades-long accountability failure under Morris + ARC-adjacent heritage without discipline. Keep red: recent elder re-formation does not yet rehabilitate institution's accountability track record.

Confirmed Assemblies of God congregation (since 1975) per WRSP/FaithStreet/AG.org directories. AG provides district credentialing and denominational oversight but is egalitarian on women's ordination and continuationist-charismatic — does not meet rubric's confessional-accountability bar (rubric green tier names PCA/OPC/SBC-confessional/CREC/LCMS/ACNA+JD). AG is not liberal-mainline (not black). Governance: senior pastor + 4 asst. pastors + deacon board (advisory) + trustees (senior pastor–directed). Keep red per refined rubric — AG's accountability actively permits female pastors, running counter to rubric's green criteria.
